name: Field Modifier — Own Field setData (location.FieldModifierLocation.field)
description: Tests calling setData directly via sdk.location.FieldModifierLocation.field — the field the modifier is installed on. Parallel to custom-field-setdata but for the Field Modifier location. The field modifier is installed on the 'headline' text field (min:5, max:100), so Zod validates type and form validates min/max constraints.

contentType.title: SDK TC FM - Field Modifier Text
contentType.description: Content type with a constrained text field for Field Modifier own-field setData tests

field_metadata.description: 5 to 100 characters — field modifier installed here

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: valid string via location.FieldModifierLocation.field → resolves
testCases.description: Calls setData directly on location.FieldModifierLocation.field with a valid string (≥5 chars). Passes Zod and form validation.

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: number via location.FieldModifierLocation.field → throws INVALID_TYPE
testCases.description: Calls setData directly on location.FieldModifierLocation.field with a number. Number fails Zod string schema for the text field.

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: boolean via location.FieldModifierLocation.field → throws INVALID_TYPE
testCases.description: Calls setData directly on location.FieldModifierLocation.field with a boolean. Boolean fails Zod string schema for the text field.

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: string too short via location.FieldModifierLocation.field → resolves, onError fires
testCases.description: Calls setData directly on location.FieldModifierLocation.field with 'Hi' (2 chars). Passes Zod (string type) but violates min_size:5 — form validation fires onError.

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: null clearing via location.FieldModifierLocation.field → resolves
testCases.description: Calls setData(null) on location.FieldModifierLocation.field. Null clears the text field.

testCases.name: Field Modifier setData: object for text field → throws INVALID_TYPE
testCases.description: Calls setData directly on location.FieldModifierLocation.field with a plain object. Object fails Zod string schema for the text field.
